titleEn: Cannot See Mom? Wait by the Post!

pages.text: "Mom, a long-tailed bird on that boat!" Bung reached from the walkway. From her tied boat, Mom called, "If you cannot see my boat, wait by the post!"
Bung wanted to show Ddori. "Come, let us see!" Holding hands, they toddled along the walkway.
The bird hopped to the next boat. Bung followed—then another boat, then another. The walkway creaked. Between shoppers' legs, only the bird showed.
The bird flew off. Bung turned. No Mom's boat! It must have moved with rising water. Bung's heart raced.
Bung turned and took a step aside. All green-awning boats looked alike. Ddori gripped Bung's clothes.
Then Mom's words returned: wait by the post. Bung looked to the walkway end. The thick post still stood. Boats moved, but the post stayed fixed above the water.
Bung drew Ddori's hand close. They went no farther and stood together by the post. "Cannot see Mom? Wait by the post! She can see us here."
Soon the noodle boat glided to the walkway. Mom spread both arms at the edge. "Bung! Ddori!"
Mom patted Bung's back. "One, cannot see me? Stop! Two, stand by the post! Three, wait until Mom comes! Cannot see Mom? Wait by the post!"
Lamp lights dotted the water. Mom rubbed her nose to Bung's cheek. "You found the post instead of wandering. We met quickly." Bung waved Ddori's hand. "Cannot see Mom? Wait by the post!"
